item.text: {"decision":"Upstream stopping review completed for all seven targeted supported premises at source revision 19. Hydraulic withdrawal is already explained within the board by supported V17 closed-path flow. Actual absence of positive restraint is already explained in the limited board sense by WP-031 omission contributing to the unblocked configuration. The limited recovered-condition node is contextual observation evidence, not a causal premise needing an upstream origin. The WP-031 omission rationale, missing recorded hold/volume/envelope checks, V17 closed-path leak defect origin, and V17 no-scheduled-seat-leak-inspection/practice origin remain at identified evidence boundaries rather than being refuted or fully explained. No new acquisition or specialist job is justified because the relevant requests have already been answered/partial with stated unavailable-in-package or retained-record limits.","operations":[],"next_work":[],"upstream_dispositions":[{"target_id":"N_R3ActualBlockAbsentUnresolved","action":"already_explained","reason":"The supported incoming edge E_WP031OmissionToBlockAbsence explains the actual no-block condition in the board's limited work-control sense: D04.S01 shows WP-031 did not instruct positive yoke blocking or retention-envelope verification, and D05.S02 shows the 13:00 event configuration had no independent positive block under YK-3. This does not explain why WP-031 omitted the instruction or prove authorization/noncompliance; those upstream questions remain bounded under R_R3ExecutionIsolation and related work-control records.","record_ids":["N_R3ActualBlockAbsentUnresolved","E_WP031OmissionToBlockAbsence","N_WP031NoBlockRetentionInstruction","R_R3ExecutionIsolation"],"source_ids":["D04","D05","USER_5258a84a5f5b"]},{"target_id":"N_R3HydraulicWithdrawalUnresolved","action":"already_explained","reason":"The supported incoming edge E_R3V17ClosedPathLeakToHydraulicWithdrawal explains this premise within the board: D08.S02 records 0.400 +/- 0.010 L leaving C17 through V17 during 13:00-13:24 despite CLOSED indication; D02.S02/D08.S03 give 100 cm2 and 1:1 travel, yielding about 40 +/- 1 mm yoke travel; D07.S02 independently measures 40 +/- 2 mm relative withdrawal, exceeding D02.S05's 30 mm primary seating engagement. This explanation is limited to support-fluid loss causing sufficient relative withdrawal and does not close keeper bypass or V17 defect-origin questions.","record_ids":["N_R3HydraulicWithdrawalUnresolved","E_R3V17ClosedPathLeakToHydraulicWithdrawal","N_R3V17ClosedPathLeakEvent"],"source_ids":["D02","D07","D08"]},{"target_id":"N_R3LimitedRecoveredCondition","action":"out_of_scope","reason":"This supported node records D01.S02's limited initial recovered-condition observations: keeper plate bolted to the recovered assembly and no reported beam/yoke fracture, with D01.S02 expressly not concluding the release mechanism. Its origin is not a physical upstream cause of the fall but an evidentiary context/condition report. Mechanism-relevant gaps are already carried by R_R3InspectionPhotos v6, which remains partial for deformation measurements, incident lateral offset/release rotation/dynamic envelope, and mark dating/loading within retained/supplied record limits.","record_ids":["N_R3LimitedRecoveredCondition","R_R3InspectionPhotos"],"source_ids":["D01","D10","D12","D14","USER_445faa931f95"]},{"target_id":"N_R3NoRecordedHoldVolumeEnvelopeCheck","action":"blocked","reason":"D05.S03 supports only the supplied-record condition that no loaded hold test, chamber-volume test, or keeper-envelope check was recorded before work began, while expressly not proving deliberate noncompliance or explaining defect origin. R_R3ExecutionIsolation v4 remains partial for completed WP-031 steps/signoffs and authorization/reason for omitted restraint or retention-envelope verification, and USER_5258a84a5f5b states the supplied package contains no additional record answering that remaining scope. Reopen if completed WP-031 forms, signoff logs, deviation/authorization/risk-assessment records, or a custodian answer from another route is produced.","record_ids":["N_R3NoRecordedHoldVolumeEnvelopeCheck","R_R3ExecutionIsolation"],"source_ids":["D05","USER_5258a84a5f5b"]},{"target_id":"N_R3V17ClosedPathLeakEvent","action":"blocked","reason":"The event-window internal V17-path flow is supported by D08.S02, but its upstream defect origin is not explained. R_R3V17LeakOriginRecords v3 is partial: D09 supplies limited post-event custody/bench-test facts and later seat contamination, but D09.S01-S03 do not timestamp contamination or establish the event leakage rate by themselves; D08.S04 says the incident meter does not establish valve wear age, contamination, or prior inspection decisions; D11/D12 state no record dates leakage or contamination onset; and USER_97c40fbbf1d8 says no additional supplied record answers contamination identity/source/timing, fluid cleanliness/debris, or repair/defect-cause analysis. Reopen if maintenance, lab, fluid-analysis, preservation, dated inspection/sample, or repair records are produced from another route.","record_ids":["N_R3V17ClosedPathLeakEvent","R_R3V17LeakOriginRecords","N_R3V17SeatContaminationEventTimingUnresolved"],"source_ids":["D08","D09","D11","D12","USER_97c40fbbf1d8"]},{"target_id":"N_R3V17NoScheduledSeatLeakInspection","action":"blocked","reason":"D11.S01 supports the retained-record/practice condition: no scheduled V17 seat-leakage inspection in the preceding year under a written replacement-when-defect-reported practice, with earlier replacements involving V18/V19 rather than V17. But D11.S02-S03 expressly do not establish that an inspection would have detected the developing V17 condition, that the practice physically created contamination, or when leakage/contamination began. The related edge E_R3V17InspectionPracticeToClosedPathLeak remains unresolved, and R_R3V17LeakOriginRecords v3 plus D12.S02 and USER_97c40fbbf1d8 identify the current evidence boundary. Reopen if a different maintenance register, inspection policy basis, dated inspection/sample, contamination-source record, or defect-cause analysis is produced.","record_ids":["N_R3V17NoScheduledSeatLeakInspection","E_R3V17InspectionPracticeToClosedPathLeak","R_R3V17LeakOriginRecords"],"source_ids":["D11","D12","USER_97c40fbbf1d8"]},{"target_id":"N_WP031NoBlockRetentionInstruction","action":"blocked","reason":"D04.S01 supports the WP-031 text omission, but D04.S03 expressly says the document does not establish why the procedure omitted positive blocking or retention-envelope verification. R_R3ExecutionIsolation v4 remains partial for completed steps/signoffs and authorization/reason for omitted restraint or retention-envelope verification, and USER_5258a84a5f5b establishes that the supplied package contains no additional record answering those fields. Prior work-control review identified only a candidate isolation-only control basis, not a supported origin. Reopen if procedure-basis, risk-assessment, deviation/authorization, completed signoff, or custodian records are produced from another route.","record_ids":["N_WP031NoBlockRetentionInstruction","R_R3ExecutionIsolation","N_WP031IsolationOnlyControlBasisCandidate"],"source_ids":["D04","D05","USER_5258a84a5f5b"]}],"disposition":"partial"}
